name: CUDA Voxelizer Pipeline
definition: A CUDA-accelerated pipeline that voxelizes 3D Gaussians into a 3D grid, sorts them per tile using radix sort, and renders/backs up gradients via tile-based blending.
summary: The CUDA Voxelizer Pipeline is a GPU-accelerated method for 3D Gaussian Splatting that voxelizes Gaussians into a 3D grid and sorts them per tile using radix sort for rendering and gradient computation.
